title: inventory-service error-rate SLO burn; upstream warehouse-api slow
symptoms: memory moved a few percentage points but stayed far from the limit
dependency health checks failing or degrading
outbound calls to a dependency approaching the client timeout
request latency well above the usual band
increase in 5xx responses seen by callers
observed_signals: caller CPU and memory stayed close to baseline
timeout logs named a specific dependency, not the local database
downstream_latency_ms on the caller rose toward the configured client timeout
error rate rose after outbound calls started timing out

timeline.event: a batch window started on warehouse-api
inventory-service began retrying calls to warehouse-api
fallback served cached responses until warehouse-api recovered

contributing_factors: a batch job on warehouse-api consumed the dependency's capacity
resolution: paused the batch job that was overloading warehouse-api
spread the job and added a shared rate limit
documented the dependency SLO in the caller runbook
lessons_learned: retry storms can look like a traffic surge on the caller
held DB connections during a slow downstream call are a side effect of waiting, not a saturated local pool
